title: Queen Elizabeth II’s final days at Balmoral Castle: Inside her 53,000-acre Scottish sanctuary
summary_full: Queen Elizabeth II spent her final days at Balmoral Castle, her beloved Scottish retreat spanning 53,000 acres. The royal estate held decades of cherished family memories, offering her peace and comfort amid nature. From royal summer holidays to her final moments, discover why Balmoral remained one of the Queen’s most treasured places throughout her life.
